title: Sunset over Ashenmoor
text:
*The sun sets over Ashenmoor, painting the grey walls in shades of gold and amber. For the first time in months, the city gate stands open — not in surrender, but in welcome. Traders are returning, ships fill the harbor, and the sound of hammers and saws echoes through streets being rebuilt.*

*You stand at the gate, looking out at the road that brought you here. So much has changed — in the city, and in you. The choices you made shaped the fate of thousands, and the echoes of those choices will resonate for years to come.*

*Whatever path you chose — to stay, to depart, to hunt — Ashenmoor will remember the stranger who arrived in grey dust and refused to look away from the darkness.*

*The ashes of gods may fall, but from them, something new always rises.*

*End of Demo*
